mapper.select: SELECT s.shift_id, s.store_id, s.store_staff_id, m.name AS staff_name, s.work_date, s.requested_start_at, s.requested_end_at, s.confirmed_start_at, s.confirmed_end_at, s.planned_break_minutes, s.status, s.staff_memo, s.owner_memo FROM shift_schedule s JOIN store_staff ss ON s.store_staff_id = ss.store_staff_id JOIN member m ON ss.member_id = m.member_id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.work_date >= #{startDate} AND s.work_date < #{endDate} ORDER BY s.work_date ASC, COALESCE(s.confirmed_start_at, s.requested_start_at) ASC
